svg.title: Alchemy execution and ownership
svg.desc: The driver prepares a batch, workers analyze individual entries, and the driver writes and scores combined outputs.
svg.text: One launcher. The driver prepares the batch, workers analyze entries independently, and the driver writes every combined output.
Read each lane from top to bottom. Entries overlap across workers; the numbered steps within each entry run in order.
Analyze one entry; several run concurrently
Collect results and finalize the run

Load the bundled cofactor catalog; resolve the CCP4
environment and record Alchemy, Gemmi, and CCP4 versions
--configure-ccp4 saves the setup path and exits here.
Acquire the exclusive output-directory lock, then sweep
scratch directories an earlier run left behind.
Classify the run mode, choose the scoring plan, and check
that existing outputs are compatible with resume.
Select entries from the mirror, downloaded cache, ID

Warm the original-PDB crystallization metadata cache
Manual input mode uses cached entries only, with no download.
Estimate per-entry memory and choose the worker-process
ceiling. Memory admission determines which entries can be
Run the worker pool: admit entries as memory permits,
watch for worker deaths, and record retryable failures
for tasks that cannot return a result.
The pool initializer installs WorkerConfig and logging

Locate or retrieve the MTZ and coordinates; read the
Convert coordinates and extract the first model; stamp
Load StructureContext and select canonical metal atoms

No selected metals, indeterminate metal presence, or more
Run mtzfix › fft › mapmask › edstats as subprocesses,
each with its own timeout. Validate the residue table,
then extract metal rows and density context.
Twin normalization is guarded recovery after MTZFIX fails.
site_summary, with declared connections, donor chemistry,
--no-bonds returns an empty analysis; failure keeps density
Merge site summaries into statistics rows; return rows,
status counts, timings, warnings, and provenance. Delete
Write site, bond, candidate, crystallization, density-
context, and score rows as entries finish. Write the
manifest row last as the completion marker.
Workers never append to the combined CSVs themselves.
Score completed entries against an explicit, output-
directory, or bundled frozen reference. Uncapped database
runs stream compact inputs and finalize them at the end.
Resume writes through staged replacements. Unsuccessful
retries never overwrite protected results, and
interrupted batches still commit finished entries.
Print the batch tally, finalize score outputs and a
reusable reference, then join REVIEW/SUSPECT sites to the
crystallization summary as the review queue.
Write the run report, including interrupted or failed
runs, and return the exit code.
Numbered cards: steps in execution order
Dashed card: decision that can end an entry early
Outlined card: final step of a lane
Solid arrows: control flow between steps
Dashed arrow: early return without maps or contacts
driver log; idle memory is released after
commands rebuild or stamp committed reference
